request.description: Dungeon Matcher native pixel-art STILL, one full-body three-quarter combat-ready enemy facing viewer-left on transparency. Whimsical, compact expressive fantasy cast. Native 64x64, grounded boots at row 62, all equipment within 2-pixel side margins. Short dwarven legs and wide torso where a dwarf. ONE-pixel #0A0D11 contour; broad connected 2-3-tone material clusters, matte top-left light, no gradient, antialias, dithering, blur, shadow outside sprite, scenery or text. Dark slate/cool iron, restrained brass, localized orange ore; distinct cloth and skin. Match source pixel density and shading, NOT its face or equipment. Wiry dwarf demolitions expert with messy POINTED RUST-RED beard, practical padded ear covers and heavy fireproof gloves. No helmet. Muted olive/slate work vest, short brown belt of small square charges. In front hand a COPPER PRESSURE DETONATOR with plunger; other hand a small SQUARE FUSE CHARGE marked by an orange fuse. Face readable, soot-dark cheek accent, mischievous alert expression. NO modern grenade, dynamite bundle, fireball or rifle.
